## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix key normalization in `Cache.set`: mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved through `get`. This review read both changed files in full and traced storage, lookup, expiry, and existing test coverage. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL from 60 to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip, default-value, and expiry tests.

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing entries — After `set("ALPHA", 1)`, both `get("ALPHA")` and `get("alpha")` return `None`. You store the original key, while `get` lowercases every lookup; the added round-trip test only writes a lowercase key. — Callers cannot retrieve mixed-case writes, and mixed-case updates leave earlier lowercase values visible. — Fix: Store entries under `key.lower()` to match lookup and deletion.
